task: Match target I-V behavior by choosing p/n doping and junction length. 1D silicon diode, not an advanced-node transistor.
simulator: DEVSIM2.11.2; finite-volume Poisson/drift-diffusion/SRH;300K;constant upstream mobility;no quantum/tunnelling/high-field/breakdown model
primary: Mean best target log-current MSE after32 queried designs versus paired random search; report all5seeds. No tuned win threshold.
secondary: Fixed heldout log-current prediction RMSE at8,16,24,32labels; no heldout label provided to model.
limits: Offline replay of an actually generated TCAD pool: all256 simulations incur generation cost. Search query savings are counterfactual, not measured wall-clock or fab savings. Target is a known synthetic reference, not a better-than-market device. Same pool shared across seeds.
qualification: Retain simulation failures. Final best designs independently rerun at double mesh density; report current conservation and mesh sensitivity.
